name: Sony Ericsson Xperia X1

images.credit: rfdigitalwpg, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: Quad-band GSM/GPRS Class 10 (4+1/3+2 slots), 32 – 48 kbit/s/EDGE: 850/900/1800/1900 MHz, Tri-band UMTS/HSDPA/HSUPA:, X1a: 850/1900/2100 MHz (/)/, X1i/X1c: 900/1900/2100 MHz ////

Platform.CPU: ARM 11 Qualcomm MSM7200A 528 MHz with 256-MHz ARM9 2nd core, hardware 3D graphics support with up to 4 million 3D triangles per second, and 133 million 3D textured pixels per second fill rate, OpenGL ES-compliant 3D graphics

Display.Display: 3.0-inch 16-bit color WVGA (800×480) TFT touchscreen, ATI 3D chip

Cameras.Rear camera: 3.2-MP (2048×1536) with flash, Video:, X1i/X1c: MPEG-4/H.263 30 fps at VGA, H.264: 15 fps at VGA, X1a: MPEG4/H.263 24 fps at QVGA, no H.264
Cameras.Front camera: Secondary QCIF (176 × 144) format front-facing video telephony camera

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 2.0 with A2DP, miniUSB 2.0, 3.5mm audio jack, aGPS, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g, no IR
